items.title: National Preparedness Month: Make a Plan
items.description:
If communications go down unexpectedly, would you know your next step? 

Take 2 minutes today:

1.  Write down your primary emergency contacts on paper and keep the list accessible.

2. Confirm primary and alternate assembly locations for your workplace and family.

A few minutes of planning now can make a big difference when an emergency happens.

Prepare today. Protect tomorrow.

items.title: Special Operations Forces tackle the unseen threat of blast exposure
items.description: In initial entry training for U.S. Special Operations Forces soldiers, low-level blast exposure can be a daily, unavoidable reality. The SOF has launched a multitude of protective measures to enhance warfighter readiness, including rolling out data-driven initiatives, implementing changes to training and equipment, and redesigning facilities based on advanced modeling of blast waves.
